name: elementor-site-team-manager
title_zh: 不知道下一步找谁时，它替你分诊整个 Elemento
tagline_zh: 从插件初始化到自定义 Widget 落地，它持续路由每个阶段。你只描述现状，它告诉你该找哪个专员、走哪条路。
tagline_en: From plugin setup to custom widgets, it routes every stage. Describe where you are, it tells you which specialist.
desc_en: Coordinate the custom Elementor Widget site workflow for users who do not know which specialist or stage to use. Invoke for kickoff, lightweight company intake, uncertain next steps, resuming an existing project, or continuous routing across plugin initialization, page content frameworks, website Design Systems, flexible page-or-module UI design, and Elementor Widget implementation. Do not use for
why_zh: 它不替你做设计或代码，而是当流程大脑：把公司轻量调研、页面框架、设计系统、UI 实现。
why_en: It doesn't build—it navigates. Chains lightweight intake, page frameworks, design systems, UI, and widget dev into a resumable.
limit_zh: 只认 Elementor 生态，不碰其他建站器。它只做路由和分诊，不产出页面、代码或设计稿。
limit_en: Elementor-only; won't route other builders. It triages but never produces pages, code, or designs. If you already know the exact widget to build.
title_en: Triage your Elementor site workflow when you don't know.
